heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There is authorized to be appropriated $660,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2019 through 2023 to carry out—

tree.text: activities authorized by this subchapter; and
other hazardous fuel reduction activities of the Secretary, including making grants to States, local governments, Indian tribes, and other eligible recipients for activities authorized by law.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2018—Pub. L. 115–334 substituted “$660,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2019 through 2023” for “$760,000,000 for each fiscal year” in introductory provisions.

ancestors.heading: HAZARDOUS FUEL REDUCTION ON FEDERAL LAND
